phrases.phrase: MHF Safeguard
Options for sending XenForo posts to your self-managed classification server.
Enable MHF Safeguard scanning
Classifier API URL
Classifier API key
Action mode
Secondary moderation threshold
Secondary revision threshold
API timeout seconds
Fail open if API is unavailable
Store cleaned message text in scan log
Store raw API response
Excluded forums
Enable synchronous scanning for new and edited XenForo posts.
Example: https://your-server.example/api/classify. The plugin sends one full cleaned message per request and the reference backend classifies it sentence by sentence.
Optional bearer token sent as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY. A strong token is recommended for every non-local deployment.

Use log, moderate, or revise. log records results without changing publication. moderate sends Ideation and Method/action content to the XenForo moderation queue. revise sends Ideation to moderation and asks the author to revise Method/action content.
Secondary policy for alternate classifier backends. The final Linear SVM backend is label-driven and its score is not a calibrated probability.
Secondary policy for alternate classifier backends. Do not interpret the final Linear SVM decision score as a calibrated probability.
Maximum time in seconds that posting waits for the classifier response.
When enabled, API failures allow normal publication; when disabled, API failures send content to moderation.
For privacy, leave this off unless controlled debugging requires stored text. The message hash is always stored.
Raw classifier responses may contain sentence text. They are only persisted when this option and message-text storage are both enabled. Leave off for normal operation.
Posts in selected forums will not be sent to the classifier API.
Your message may contain method/action content that needs revision before posting. Please remove or reword the highlighted harmful method/action language and try again.
